category: research testbed - distributed compute + 0.5-1 PB file storage

free_tier.stated: VMs up to 64 cores / 384 GB RAM with directly attached NVMe, GPUs, SmartNICs; 'large storage volumes'; facility holds 'between 1/2 and 1PB of file storage space' for experiment data, plus experiment-attached block storage

retention.stated: Bastion keys expire in 6 months, sliver keys in 2 years.

egress.terms: free; on-demand 25-100 Gbps inter-site links, public IPv4/IPv6 peering, Internet2 100 Gbps cloud peering

interface_detail: fablib Python API, JupyterHub, portal; ssh via bastion.fabric-testbed.net
tooling: fablib, FABRIC CLI, Jupyter notebooks with preloaded tokens
chaining: slice with NVMe + block storage; the management plane is explicitly not a data path
limits_note: Slices have 'a finite lifetime, but can typically be extended before they expire'. Management plane is rate-limited to ~1 Gbps and 'has traffic filtering rules to prevent hosting Internet-facing services' - so you cannot serve from the control network, only from experiment links. Identity is CILogon/InCommon R&S, i.e. an institutional IdP. Bastion keys expire in 6 months, sliver keys in 2 years.
reliability_note: Explicitly 'experimental and no production'; not expected to provide production-grade reliability.

evidence.proved: 'The facility has between 1/2 and 1PB of file storage space'; VMs 'with storage in the form of dedicated NVMe drives and slower, but larger persistent block storage'; 'The portal and Jupyter Hub use federated identity through CI Logon and support any institutional identity provider that is part of InCommon R&S'

'Management plane is rate-limited to about 1Gbps ... has traffic filtering rules to prevent hosting Internet-facing services and should not be used as part of experiment data flows'; 'Slices have a finite lifetime'
international nodes exist at CERN, University of Amsterdam, Bristol, Tokyo, but framed as partner facilities, not individual access
facility holds between 1/2 and 1PB of file storage
evidence.quote: The facility has between ½ and 1PB of file storage space to help ease moving measurement and other experiment-related data in- and out- of experiments in programmatic fashion.

evidence.proved: federated identity requires an institutional identity provider in InCommon R&S
evidence.quote: The portal and Jupyter Hub use federated identity through CI Logon and support any institutional identity provider that is part of InCommon R&S (Research and Scholarship) federation.
Bastion public keys are expired 6 months after their creation.

evidence.proved: management plane is shaped to about 1Gbps and cannot host Internet-facing services
evidence.quote: Management plane is rate-limited to about 1Gbps and shared among many experimenters. It has traffic filtering rules to prevent hosting Internet-facing services and should not be used as part of experiment data flows.

evidence.proved: the testbed does not provide production-grade reliability
evidence.quote: by virtue of being experiments, they can’t be expected to provide production-grade reliability and robustness.
